summary: Bonner County, ID peak on Kaniksu NF: a 1931 fire finder, a tower guessed for about 1947, staff listed for 1949; abandoned, with footings found on a 2025 hike.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; cement footings and lumber were found on the peak on a September 2025 visit

visit.trail_note: Hike-in only. In September 2025 the trailhead the visitors planned to use was roped off and closed when they reached it, with a slow-moving fire a few miles away; they walked a nearby trail instead, and it was overgrown in places

events.note: Listed as a fire finder site; no tower mentioned
Idaho Fire Lookouts dates a tower or cabin here to 1942 with a question mark; a 1942 map shows a Lookout Station
Approximate. Inferred by Idaho Fire Lookouts from two 1947 benchmarks; they guess a larger tower was built about then
Bob Kurth and Arnold Krause listed as known staff

notes_for_editor: Only the 1931 fire finder listing is sourced directly; the 1947 tower date is an inference from benchmarks that the Idaho Fire Lookouts writers themselves call a guess. No source gives a year for abandonment, so no abandoned event was added. Do not confuse with us-id-trout-peak-2 (Idaho County camp, a different site). The record had no events; the events above come from the sources. The site's current access rules are not stated in any source read.
